_note: How a published X video post is laid out, measured on the desk's own #FINVideo posts. Built by build.py; do not edit by hand.

identifier.rule: A post is an X video post exactly when it carries #FINVideo. Every other count in this directory is over such posts only.

layout.line_1: the title (headline, then an optional suffix)
layout.last_line: all hashtags, then all @handles, space separated

tag_order_now.rule: brand tag first, #FINVideo second (since 21 Nov 2026; before that #FINVideo came first)

file_name_title.rule: The share file's name, without the x / done marks and the extension, is often the posted title. Windows does not allow '|' in a name, so the desk types two or more spaces where the title has ' | '.
file_name_title.measured: 27 Nov 2026: the heading of all 29 posted videos is a file name on the share (26 within 0.75 letter similarity, 3 the same heading with a longer suffix); 22 of those 29 files carried no x mark. X-marked files 22-27 Nov: 130 of 230 names hold a full heading, the rest a word ('KOTAA', 'JDR Hadsa').
